prediction.model: LightGBM on physics features + Sightglass rationale engine
prediction.rationale:
Cooler: full efficiency. Evidence: TS1 mean temperature 36.0 °C (within 1% of healthy); TS2 mean temperature 41.6 °C (within 1% of healthy). Thermal characteristics align with nominal continuous cooling performance.
Valve: optimal. Evidence: PS2 pressure rise time 9.39 s (within 1% of healthy); PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 9.89 s (within 1% of healthy). Directional valve actuates cleanly with no discernible switching hesitation.
Pump leakage: weak leakage. Evidence: FS1 mean volume flow 6.51 l/min (within 1% of healthy); EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 391 W·min/l (2% above healthy); SE system efficiency factor 57.1 % (3% below healthy). Volumetric delivery is slightly compromised due to minor internal bypass flow.
Accumulator: optimal. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 47.1 bar (within 1% of healthy). Hydraulic accumulator effectively dampens load transients with normal pre-charge.
